question_text:
Passage: The Philippine Senate recently approved Senate Resolution No. 1234, urging the national government to increase the budget allocation for basic education by at least 20% in the next fiscal year. The resolution, sponsored by Senator Maria Santos, cites the need to address classroom shortages, hire more teachers, and improve learning materials. It also recommends that the Department of Education (DepEd) submit a detailed report on the utilization of current funds to ensure accountability. The resolution is non-binding but reflects the Senate's commitment to prioritizing education.

Which of the following can be INFERRED from the passage?

options.text: The national government will definitely increase the education budget by 20%.
The Senate has the power to mandate budget increases.
There is concern about how current education funds are being used.
Senator Maria Santos is the Secretary of Education.
